payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses KMP string matching to find all non-overlapping occurrences of word subsegments, then computes minimal length after abbreviation by trying all subsegments.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over all possible subsegments and uses KMP to count repeated occurrences, lacking any dynamic programming table or memoization; thus, it does not belong to the DP family, but it resembles a 2D state enumeration.
